title: 2025 in review: 315 stories about solutions and progress
text:
Squirrel News Team | Posted on December 31, 2025 |

Photo: Mathew Smith/Unsplash (CC0)

With 2025 drawing to a close, we’re taking a look back at some of the most exciting developments taking place over the course of the year: from environmental protection measures to new policies reducing social inequality and much more.
